```{r}
#General utility packages
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)

# read nifti
library(oro.nifti)

library(effectsize)

#Plot pacakges
library(wesanderson)
pal <- wes_palette("Zissou1", 100, type = "continuous")

```

```{r}


# read the roi and atlas file. 
roi.list<-read.csv2('assets/script/Regions_IDs_split.csv',sep=';')

design <- read_csv('assets/nifti/pre/design.csv')
img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/heatmaps_rs_smooth.nii.gz')
atlas_img<-readNIfTI('assets/script/rs_atlas_split.nii.gz')
mask_img <- readNIfTI('assets/nifti/pre/mask_corr.nii.gz')
contrast_img<-mask_img

atlas_img<-atlas_img*mask_img

df <- data.frame(name=character(),
                 acronym=character(),
                 g=double(), 
                 lower=double(), 
                 upper=double(),
                 stringsAsFactors=FALSE) 
ii<-0

# loop through all rois
for(i in 1:dim(roi.list)[1]){
  ID<-roi.list[i,'id']
  acronym<-roi.list[i,'acronym']
  name<-roi.list[i,'name']
  selectROI<-which(atlas_img[,,] == ID)
  
  #if not empty list of voxels, get the sum for each mouse
  if(length(selectROI)>0){
    print(acronym)
    tmp_sumlist<-c()
    for(j in 1:dim(img)[4]){
      tmp<-img[,,,j]
      tmp_sumlist[j]<-sum(tmp[selectROI])
    }
    if(sum(tmp_sumlist==0)==length(tmp_sumlist)){next}
    g <- hedges_g(tmp_sumlist~ design$Group)
    df[ii,'name']<-name
    df[ii,'acronym']<-acronym
    df[ii,'g']<-g$Hedges_g
    df[ii,'lower']<-g$CI_low
    df[ii,'upper']<-g$CI_high
    contrast_img[selectROI]<-g$Hedges_g
    ii<-ii+1}
  
  
  
}


plot <- df %>% 
  mutate(acronym = fct_reorder(acronym, g, min)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=acronym, y=g, colour=g))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype='dashed')+
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin=lower, ymax=upper))+ 
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(text = element_text(size = 6), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")+
  scale_color_gradientn(colours = pal)+
  labs(y = "PTSD-like > resilient [Hedge\'s g]", title = 'Pre condition', x='')


df %>% arrange(g) %>% write_csv('assets/script/pre_roi.csv') 
writeNIfTI(contrast_img,'assets/script/pre_g')

```
